notes.title: Total sales reached 150,000 units! Free distribution of some DLC!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36246473/8c1465216db0a4464fce5219d482650467efa27b.png[/img]

Thank you for playing “Omega Labyrinth Life”.

Thanks to your generous support, we are pleased to announce that the cumulative sales of “Omega Labyrinth Life” have reached 150,000 units. We would like to express our sincere gratitude to all the users of this title and to all those who have given us their support and encouragement. 
To commemorate this achievement, we have made the following downloadable content available for free at the following prices.

[b]＜Free DLC＞[/b]
- Vox Ecstalispear
- Vox Bluriades
- Vox Munechika
- Vox Mastilteinn
- Vox Breasickle
- Vox Tituceus
- Vox Brysteleif

Thank you for your continued support of “Omega Labyrinth Life”.

Thanks!
Team Omega Labyrinth Life

notes.title: Advance notice of free pricing for some DLC
notes.content:
Thank you for playing “Omega Labyrinth Life”.

Thanks to your generous support, sales of this title have been steady since its launch in 2019. We would like to express our sincere gratitude to you.
As a way to thank all of you for your support, we will soon be revising the prices of the following DLC and plan to make them available for free.

[b]<DLC to be made free of charge>[/b]
- Vox Ecstalispear
- Vox Bluriades
- Vox Munechika
- Vox Mastilteinn
- Vox Breasickle
- Vox Tituceus
- Vox Brysteleif

*The new price is scheduled to be revised on December 18, 2024 at around 18:00 (PST).

We would like to ask those who are considering purchasing the above DLC to please take note of this.

Thank you for your continued support of “Omega Labyrinth Life”.

Thanks!
Team Omega Labyrinth Life
